title: SEED-Bench-2: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the technical capabilities (comprehension and generation) of Multimodal Large Language Models across various dimensions like scene understanding, instance identity, text recognition, and image generation. There is no mention of evaluating or benchmarking the models' understanding or adherence to religion, morals, or ethics as part of its assessment framework. The term 'objective and efficient assessment' refers to the evaluation methodology to reduce subjectivity, not an ethical evaluation of the MLLMs themselves.
